summary: SQM (Chemical and Mining Company of Chile Inc.) filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Board of Directors approved an interim dividend of US$1.43501 per share, charged against 2026 net income. The dividend will be paid in Chilean pesos, converted at the observed dollar rate published on September 4, 2026. Payment to shareholders registered five business days prior occurs from September 11, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special-situation restructuring or transaction. No advisors, board recommendation, or unusual mechanics are disclosed. Watch for currency conversion details and any subsequent changes in dividend policy or capital allocation.
